Performance comparison between most powerful LLMs and MathGLM on various multi-

evidence_items.explanation: Mixed-arithmetic accuracy falls overall from 85.16% at five digits to 41.05% at twelve, but rises from 67.69% at eight to 69.60% at nine. Training includes 50,000 additional records extending to twelve digits; this is not a clean test of unseen lengths or similarity dependence.

unresolved_gaps: No located MathGLM analysis isolates training-example similarity from arithmetic difficulty.
The reported behavioral results do not identify whether the model learned an abstract multiplication procedure.
The calculator comparison is an assumed ideal reference, not an experimentally measured baseline.
